plan_interpretation: The plan names 'the current DailyMed label of each of the ten catalogue drugs ... the NDA or BLA holder's'. Several drugs have more than one NDA label (bortezomib 5, cyclophosphamide 9, dexamethasone 10, melphalan 3, daratumumab 2 in the candidate file), so the fixed label for each is the catalogue's own reference label (drug_safety_v2), chosen before the draw. Nine are NDA or BLA labels; fludarabine has no NDA or BLA label in the candidate file and its catalogue label is an ANDA label; the HEMADY label is not in the candidate file (no current NDC listing there). The ten fixed set IDs are excluded from the draw, as the plan says.
downloads: Each label as a zip from https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/downloadzipfile.cfm?setId=<set ID>, into supplemental-information/dailymed/pilot/ on the owner's iMac; spares are downloaded too, and used only to replace refused labels, in order.
